args.message:
Bump fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested
arrays, affecting fastjson < 2.9.4. Upgrade to the fixed 2.9.4 release
on the same major version.

files.content:
# Changelog

## Unreleased

- Security: upgraded fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337 (unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays).

args.body:
## Summary
- Upgrades fastjson from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4` in `requirements.txt`.
- Fixes **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays, affecting fastjson < 2.9.4 on the 2.x line.
- 2.9.4 is the minimal, same-major-version fix (3.1.0 also fixes it, but staying on 2.x avoids breaking API changes).

## Testing
- CI passed on this branch (run `ci-0001`).
